title: Which question a byte comparison answers, and what each answer may say
note: D-2026-101. RP1-RP18: the verdict and the backend identity in scientific/reproduction.py -- unresolved never different, a witnessed backend's drift never excused, strict never answered off the reference, the profile applicable only to the corpus, closure, exemptions and lock it binds, and every part of the arithmetic path in the identity. RP19-RP29 targeted the witness tool, the instrumented wrapper and the package checker, which left with the retired programme.
